changes.old: It made the family stop speaking to one another.
changes.new: It worked because the family stopped reviewing the rule.
它之所以有效，是因為家人停止檢討規則。

changes.old: 兩名兄妹常為共用書桌爭執。家人訂出輪流使用時間，並容許有需要時交換。哪句最貼切？
changes.new: 兩名兄妹常為共用書桌爭執。家人訂出輪流使用時間，容許有需要時交換，之後爭執明顯減少。哪句最貼切？

changes.old: The schedule proves the siblings never disagreed.
changes.new: The timetable worked because neither sibling was allowed to swap times.

changes.old: 時間表證明兄妹從未有分歧。
changes.new: 時間表之所以有效，是因為兄妹都不准交換時段。

changes.old: A clear rule requires everyone to argue every night.
changes.new: The rota clarified turns, but the nightly desk arguments continued as before.

changes.old: 清晰規則要求各人每晚爭吵。
changes.new: 輪值表說清了先後次序，但每晚的書桌爭執仍如往常。

changes.old: It has no electronic equipment at all.
changes.new: It has many devices, so beginners must have struggled with the controls.
它有很多設備，所以初學者一定覺得操作困難。

changes.old: The room contains no electronic features.
changes.new: The half-hour learning period shows the controls are intuitive for first-time guests.
花半小時學習操作，顯示首次入住的客人能直覺使用。

changes.old: The room must be easy for every guest because it has devices.
changes.new: The room is gadget-heavy mainly because its furniture is physically weighty.

changes.old: 房間有設備，所以每位住客一定覺得易用。
changes.new: 房間之所以電子設備繁多，主要是因為傢俬實際很重。

changes.old: 展覽設備雖然繁多，學生在簡短導覽示範後也能使用電子顯微鏡。
changes.new: 展覽電子設備雖然繁多，學生在簡短導覽示範後也能使用電子顯微鏡。
